scope: Read-only source and license research for EngineIdle, EngineCruise, EnginePower, Propeller and OpenCockpitWind

network_method.fallback: Read-only HTTP requests to first-party library, archive and license pages

license_sources.project_interpretation: Potentially suitable for cooked-game synchronization after purchase and confirmation of the correct user or team license. Raw or readily extractable audio must not ship.
Useful as an identity reference. Share-alike, attribution, source quality and perspective make it unsuitable for binding without a separate legal and audio review.
The DCS Yak-52 product confirms authentic Yak-52 recordings exist, but installed-product audio cannot be extracted or reused.

blocked_or_ambiguous_sources.reason: The product page says its sounds were recorded from a Yak-52, while the EULA reserves sound rights and prohibits reverse engineering or derivative extraction.
Interior flight pages do not document an open rear canopy, airspeed, microphone position or isolated airflow.
